SOFTWARE LICENSE AND SUPPORT AGREEMENT

This Agreement governs Client's use of the inventory management system
licensed by Palo Robotics Inc. ("Licensor").

1. License Grant. Licensor grants Client a non-exclusive, non-transferable
license to use the system for Client's internal business operations
during the term of this Agreement.

2. Support. Licensor shall provide system updates and bug fixes at no
additional cost during the support period, and shall respond to a
system-down ticket within four business hours.

3. Acceptable Use. Client shall not reverse-engineer, decompile, or
attempt to derive the source code of the system, and shall not permit
access to the system by any party outside Client's organization.

4. Fees. Client shall pay an annual license fee of $36,000, invoiced at
the start of each contract year, plus a one-time $5,000 implementation
fee due upon signing.

5. Termination. Either party may terminate this Agreement for material
breach not cured within thirty (30) days of written notice.
